title: Animal off/on display
preconditions: Seeded DB. Open `console-operations.html`. Pick an outdoor animal guests can find on the map (e.g. **Raccoon** / **Canadian Domain**).
dateUnderTest: **D** = a specific future date (record YYYY-MM-DD). Use D on map and itinerary verifies.
cleanup: End with animal **on display** for D (run **Set animal as on display** if needed).

steps.name: Date range + reason
steps.do: Set start ≤ D (**Last day** blank or ≥ D). Enter **Reason**.
steps.expect: Fields valid; blank **Last day** means until manually on-display.

steps.name: Submit off display
steps.expect: Success status like “{species} in {exhibit} was set as off display.”

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: Open `map.html`, **Specific Map**, date D. Leave **Include off display animals** unchecked.
steps.expect: Animal absent or not shown as normally on-display (per product rules).

steps.name: Map with include
steps.expect: Animal appears and/or off-display banner/message is shown.

steps.name: Itinerary confirm
steps.do: On `itinerary.html` for date D, try adding the animal (enable **Include off-display animals** if needed).
steps.expect: Off-display / low-likelihood confirm appears, or animal listing reflects off-display — note which.

steps.name: Set on display
steps.do: In console, open **Set animal as on display** for the same species/exhibit/scope.

steps.name: Submit on display
steps.expect: Success status like “… was set as on display.”

steps.name: Map restored
steps.do: On map for D with include-off-display **off**.
steps.expect: Animal shows as a normal on-display marker again.

steps.name: Cleanup confirmed
steps.do: Confirm no leftover off-display for D.
